doc.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Hearing 'Spectacular' with Cannonball Adderley
summary: Rowe plays a 1956 track with Cannonball and Nat Adderley; Mance identifies the tune and rhythm section.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: I wanted to play a little snippet of something from your early career.
Well in those days, and see if it rings a bell with you.
Is that — that’s not from that jam session album with Dinah Washington?
No, this is with Cannonball and Nat. The tune is called “Spectacular.”
[scats] “Spectacular” right, yeah. Jimmy Cobb on drums and Sam Jones. You know when that was? 1956. Forty something years, forty two years ago.
